run_soccerball_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads multiple soccer balls and a ground plane with gravity
load_urdf_soccerball: load a soccerball URDF model into pybullet with a specified position and global scaling factor
change_dynamics_ball: change the linear damping, angular damping, rolling friction, and spinning friction of a pybullet body
change_visual_shape_color: change the RGBA color of a pybullet body's visual shape to a light gray
set_gravity_simulation: set the gravity vector for the pybullet simulation to simulate downward force
